title: Universal Media Decomposer plan decomposition
body: Created six sequential implementation plans A-F because the approved DD/final estimate classify the work as EPIC and a single plan would exceed manager/worker validation scope. A establishes the shared reducer, semantic ledger, OCFL, migrations, locators, and provenance; B adds Hatchet-only durable jobs plus text/image; C adds sandbox/providers plus audio/video/independent subtitles; D adds reversible resolution/alignment, replay projections, search/query/API; E adds operations/deployment/docs/extension gates; F owns full matrix and correction→invalidation→selective-rerun cross-tier E2E. Created shared README and CONTRACTS.md because no prior plan/contract artifacts existed. Support-Librarian confirmed DD_REQUIRED IMMUTABLE, T1-T8 complete, AMEND_AND_PASS approval, no ADR/ASR infrastructure, and open gates must remain explicit. Plan parser validation passed for every phase of all six plans.

title: Semantic capability repair planning scope
body: Repository inspection confirms current production.py still normalizes every text-like source through normalize_txt and always segment_txt; _parser_for only labels parser and is not invoked through the shared sandbox dispatch, while EPUB/Markdown segmenters and extractors already exist. Entity resolution currently emits one source-derived canonical placeholder and reconciliation one RECONCILED_SOURCE assertion. Existing ModelProvider, typed Evidence/SemanticAssertion, append-only ledger/reducer, bounded QueryService, and replay builders are reusable. Plan must add real format-dispatch composition, typed semantic stage contract, multi-entity resolution, rich reconciliation, replay/read-side multi-edge, and fixture/public E2E without altering Hatchet/OCFL/ledger authority.

title: Plan L amendment decisions
body: Amending Plan L for QA Round 1 planning gaps. Preserve the existing nine-stage DAG, Hatchet/job topology, OCFL source authority, typed PostgreSQL evidence/segments, append-only semantic ledger, idempotency/retry/invalidation, and generic media domain. Chose the bounded contract correction: CONTRACTS.md will state TXT and viable text-PDF extracted-text segmentation use the plain-text document/chapter/section/paragraph/sentence/token baseline, while Markdown and EPUB retain their native document/chapter/section/paragraph and document/chapter/paragraph hierarchies. Chose the minimal EPUB safety repair: preflight and enforce a 512 MiB total declared decompressed-byte cap in in-process extract_epub, matching SandboxLimits.max_decompressed_bytes, with tests for rejection and no unbounded reads. Reopen completed Plan L steps whose claims are invalid (P1-S3/P1-S4, P2-S1/P2-S2, P3-S2/P3-S3), preserve their annotations, and add focused re-execution steps for single dispatch reuse through STRUCTURAL_ANALYSIS, structural-path pairing, full-DAG/no-fabrication coverage, retry pairing, decompression bound, and documentation refresh.

title: Plan N representation decision
body: Amendment chooses Option B in a ledger-first text-reference form. Production resolution keeps SourceMention.entity_id NULL because entity_mention.entity_id is a nullable UUID FK and no entity-table materialization is authorized/needed. Resolved identity is represented by EntityResolved(ALIAS) events with alias_ref equal to deterministic mention_id and canonical_ref equal to the deterministic service string; the reducer/current_state exposes the decision. Resolver.alias must append the ledger event but only write current_entity_map when both refs are UUID-backed (legacy/materialized resolver paths), because current_entity_map also has UUID FKs. Query/search must reconcile from current_state for text refs and exclude resolved mention IDs from UNRESOLVED_ALIASES. No migration or DAG/topology change. Keep ALIAS alias_ref=mention_id for deterministic reversible references.

title: Plan O QA amendment strategy
body: Amending Plan O with one Phase 4. Chosen deterministic freshness strategy: SearchProjectionBuilder serializes against the semantic_edges advisory lock, verifies the semantic_edges checkpoint has reached the search replay target before finalize reads active edges, aborts without publishing search checkpoint if dependency lagged, and delete-then-reindexes all edge-derived docs (including cleanup of legacy assertion-derived edge docs) from active edge rows. Edge-derived structured/semantic reads will select edge_guard. Mirror materialization will preserve USER_OVERRIDE precedence and skip locked machine writes, with override/correction mirror handling and regression tests. No ADR/ASR directories exist.

title: Plan O final utterance reconciliation amendment
body: Amended Plan O with Phase 5 after QA Round 2. The deterministic mechanism is to keep the existing SearchProjectionBuilder finalize freshness gate (semantic_edges advisory lock plus checkpoint lag abort), then delete both edge:% and assert:% document families and reindex active edges from active_semantic_edge: edge:{fact_id} for non-utterance predicates and assert:{fact_id} for SPEAKS/SAYS/UTTERANCE/PRONUNCIATION. Added correction/override and lag-window regression requirements plus four documentation repairs and alignment sentences. Updated CONTRACTS.md binding search reconciliation contract. No ADR/ASR infrastructure exists; Phases 1-4 remain untouched.

title: Provider promotion seam and bounded hydration choice
body: Research confirms the repair is a single production seam: _structural_analysis already commits validated provider semantic_observation evidence; _semantic_reconciliation must not re-invoke providers. _reconciliation_input should retain deterministic baseline and rehydrate only committed semantic_analysis evidence rows, validating heterogeneous observations against existing typed Pydantic models with exact segment locator membership. Existing SemanticReconciler/ledger/current-state/edge/search/query/question paths already consume typed observations. Provider candidate generated_by metadata remains authoritative per observation; top-level reconciliation path stays deterministic. Malformed/unsupported/gated/no-model rows yield baseline-only behavior with warnings. Update strict provider-gap tests in lockstep; do not alter deterministic search human-readable limitation or Q's historical release report semantics until implementation verification.

title: Plan T requirement gap discovery
body: Baseline research confirms Plan S limitations directly conflict with this ledger: production.py resolves twice (ENTITY_RESOLUTION and SEMANTIC_RECONCILIATION), canonical_entity_ref hashes source-bound mention IDs, same-work name seeding is too permissive, ENTITY/search membership filters are absent, manual POST uses bare CANONICAL_ENTITY assertion, and generic RELATED_TO/relationship_type is absent. Public and hosted gates exist but current live Hatchet evidence is not green; Plan T must make hosted green a hard completion gate and use public HTTP ingestion/full nine-stage composition as primary acceptance.

title: Plan T identity-anchor implementation uncertainty
body: The current canonical_entity_ref(member_ids) cannot satisfy cross-source inverse-order equality because SourceMention IDs intentionally include source identity. Plan T must introduce a stable accepted-evidence identity-anchor material independent of source/filename/job/order while retaining same-name coexistence and reversible merge/split. The plan leaves internal anchor packaging to implementation but binds observable invariants and requires permutation tests; no new persistence authority or fabricated human-readable IDs is allowed.
